title: The buddy system
heading: The buddy system
coreClaim: The chapter argues that good decision-making improves when another person can challenge your stories, evidence, and revisions instead of leaving you alone with self-serving judgment.
distinctMechanism: A trusted buddy system provides outside correction that keeps belief calibration and post-outcome learning more honest.
requiredAnchors: The buddy system as a truth-seeking decision tool.
Outside challenge as protection against self-serving narratives.
The difference between supportive correction and simple reassurance.
commonMisreadings: The chapter is mainly about emotional comfort.
Any agreeable partner counts as a good decision buddy.
specificApplications: Use a thinking partner to test confidence and evidence before decisions.
Review outcomes with someone willing to challenge your rewrite.
Build social accountability into updating and forecasting.
hardEdgeRequirement: Preserve the tension between trust, honesty, and real challenge.
thresholdQuestion: What kind of outside voice improves truth instead of simply protecting your feelings?
